name: git-control-tower
description: Single source of truth for the complete observable git-control-tower CLI surface. Typed Connect-RPC bindings are the target for scenario operations; local command registrations remain declared during the domain migration. Schema-validated against cli-manifest/v1 and cross-validated against owned proto descriptors.

groups.name: worktree
groups.description: Manage git worktrees via the WorktreeService Connect-RPC surface

commands.name: create
commands.description: Create a worktree from an existing branch, new branch (with optional start point + tracking), or detached commit

flags.name: existing_branch
flags.description: Existing branch to check out (mutually exclusive with --new-branch / --commit)

flags.name: new-branch
flags.description: New branch name to create (mutually exclusive with --branch / --commit)
flags.bind_waiver: The worktree CLI adapter combines this name with --start-point and --track into NewBranchSpec.

flags.name: track
flags.description: Set --track for the new branch's upstream

flags.name: commit
flags.description: Detached HEAD commit SHA (mutually exclusive with --branch / --new-branch)

flags.name: force
flags.description: Force-create even if the target path is dirty

flags.name: force
flags.description: Force removal even if the worktree is dirty

flags.name: reason
flags.description: Optional lock reason recorded by git

commands.name: move
commands.description: Move a worktree to a new path

commands.name: prune
commands.description: Prune worktree records that no longer have a valid working tree on disk

flags.name: reason
flags.description: Optional reason recorded in the audit log

flags.name: report-only
flags.description: Report what would be pruned without modifying state

groups.name: repo
groups.description: Inspect and change repository state through typed repository operations

commands.name: groups
commands.description: Resolve changed files into manual, contract-derived, and builtin groups

commands.name: diff
commands.description: Show a working-tree or staged file diff

commands.name: blame
commands.description: Show bounded native Git line attribution with optional provenance enrichment

commands.name: stage
commands.description: Review an exact file selection and stage it

commands.name: unstage
commands.description: Review an exact file selection and unstage it

commands.name: commit
commands.description: Review an exact server preview and create a single-use-authorized validated commit (--yes skips the prompt)

groups.name: branch
groups.description: Manage repository branches through the BranchService Connect-RPC surface

groups.name: review
groups.description: Run and inspect scenario readiness reviews

groups.name: audit
groups.description: Query the Git Control Tower audit log

groups.name: baseline
groups.description: Capture, compare, and govern durable behavioral and source evidence

commands.name: snapshot
commands.description: Start or inspect a durable single-scenario baseline snapshot

commands.name: diff
commands.description: Start or inspect a durable baseline comparison

commands.name: delete
commands.description: Delete a baseline and release its pin

commands.name: repair
commands.description: Preview or apply deterministic baseline lifecycle repair

commands.name: collection
commands.description: Operate durable multi-scenario validation evidence collections

commands.name: path
commands.description: Capture and compare bounded informational source evidence

commands.name: start
commands.description: Start a shadow or live engagement

commands.name: abandon
commands.description: Abandon an engagement and restore owned state
